exposure: high-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) combined with UGSC
uterine artery embolization (UAE) combined with UGSC
cohort: The study included 434 patients diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) from a single tertiary referral center between January 2015 and December 2020.
finding: UGSC is an effective and safe option for low-risk cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP), while HIFU or UAE combined with UGSC demonstrates higher efficacy for high-risk CSP, with HIFU potentially superior in reducing bleeding and increasing beta-HCG decline.
